title: The Cursed Pumpkin
summary: Stealth-resource hot-potato game with sealed guesses and an epoch-timed holder reveal. The public browser replays the creator’s October 28 four-player Esmeralda game and links each of 23 recorded transactions; October 29 inspection confirmed replay steps advance. A separate live view and Sapient ownership-check tab are provided. Playing new games uses the Python client and testnet bonds; the browser replay is not a new multiplayer match. Timing, pass counts, the host’s first hop, off-chain information and the final revealed holder remain observable. A holder who never reveals causes partial bond refunds. MIT source reviewed; no wallet access, ownership signing or payments were performed.
cardSummary: Replay a secret hot-potato game and compare public transaction clues with the hidden route of its single pumpkin.
creator: iammzee

recording.credit: App demo — Interactive replay of the creator’s recorded October 28 testnet game; no new transactions.
